basis_boundary.dividends: excluded from first-wave geometry/economic ruler unless separately admitted
basis_boundary.geometry: authoritative effective split-event adjusted price only; feature construction is as-of and cannot ingest future split events
basis_boundary.volume: historical share volume transformed by the reciprocal price factor across an admitted split so participation is on consistent share-count basis

atr14.episode_freeze: Evaluate on admitted as-of split-adjusted OHLC at the immutable first eligible near-boundary landmark and freeze that ATR value for the episode.
atr14.formula: Wilder EWM(alpha=1/14, min_periods=14, adjust=False) of true_range=max(|H-L|,|H-prevC|,|L-prevC|)

proposed_exact_adapter.missing_rule: fewer than 252 valid strictly-prior BBW observations => unavailable; never shorten the window

why_native_wrapper_is_not_equivalent: pct_rank_window ranks a rolling window that includes the current observation
pct_rank_window uses min_periods=window//2, so a 252-window emits after 126 observations
TOI R0 requires comparison to exactly 252 strictly prior valid BBW observations

native_compression_release.reason: native squeeze family is BB/KC squeeze grammar, whereas TOI R0 freezes prior-range geometry plus BBW percentile formation; retain native family only as separately identified incumbent/control if later admitted

proposed_exact_adapter.basis: share volume carried consistently with authoritative effective split factors; prices divided by cumulative factor and historical share counts multiplied by that factor
proposed_exact_adapter.missing_rule: missing current row or any required comparable-bar contract violation => unavailable; do not bridge a spell boundary

why_native_wrapper_is_not_equivalent: _rvol divides by a 20-bar rolling mean that includes current volume
_rvol fills missing/zero source volume into zero-valued output semantics
TOI R0 requires current completed volume divided by the prior 20 comparable completed bars and missing comparable history to be unavailable

warmup.derivation: first BBW exists at raw bar 20; 252 strictly prior BBW observations require current raw bar >=272; five consecutive qualified current states require bars 272..276
